item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud glu ru'i thugs bcud las nyams khrid 'phrul mdzod zhus lan bdun pa rlung sems 'od gsal khrid rim dri med ras dkar
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro bdag gis thugs kyi bcud ltar bsdus/ ma 'ongs dus 'dir skal ldan khyed la gtad/ gsang sbas zab mo'i man ngag sa ma ya/ rgya/ kho bo byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyis snyan du brgyud pa'o//
